{ff02}In KENO, 16 numbers are drawn
from 1 to 64 each play.
Guess which ones and place your bet!{ff01}{ff02}You can pick anywhere from
1 to 16 numbers. Your choice!{ff01}{ff02}Put the cursor on NO.SEL and press
Circle, and a cursor appears on the
number board so you can pick.{ff01}{ff02}Press Circle to choose. Your picks
light up red. Press Circle again
to cancel and the light goes off.{ff01}{ff02}Pick numbers and the odds table
shows on the right. "1 x4" means if
one pick hits, your coins go x4.{ff01}{ff02}When you're done, press X to BET.
Circle bets 1 coin at a time,
Triangle bets 10 at a time.{ff01}{ff02}X takes off 1 coin, Square takes
off 10. You can bet up to
100 coins!{ff01}{ff02}ERASE turns off all the lights.
Use it to pick again from scratch.{ff01}{ff02}RESULT shows past draws. Red came
up often, blue rarely, green about
average. Choose wisely!{ff01}{ff02}After betting, press R1 to start!
Press L1 when you want to quit.
The MAX payout is 999999 coins!{ff01}
